cues.pushupCue: Keep your knees supported and your trunk aligned. Lower with control, then press through your hands.
cues.squatCue: Stand with your feet comfortably apart. Sit down between your hips, keeping your feet grounded, then stand tall.
cues.bridgeCue: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet grounded. Lift your hips without arching your lower back.
cues.birdDogCue: From hands and knees, extend the opposite arm and leg while keeping your trunk steady. Alternate sides.
cues.deadBugCue: Lie on your back with your arms up and knees bent. Slowly extend opposite limbs while keeping your trunk steady.
cues.plankCue: Support yourself on your forearms. Maintain a straight line through your trunk and breathe steadily. Hold for the displayed time.
cues.pressCue: Lie on a stable bench. Lower the dumbbells beside your chest with control, then press them upward.
cues.rowCue: Support one hand on a stable bench. Pull the dumbbell towards your hip without rotating your trunk.
cues.shoulderCue: Keep your ribs controlled as you press the dumbbells overhead through a comfortable range.
cues.hingeCue: Keep the dumbbells close to your legs. Move your hips back with softly bent knees, then return to standing.
cues.catCowCue: From hands and knees, slowly round and extend your spine through a comfortable range while breathing steadily.
cues.hipCue: Sit with your knees bent. Gently rotate your hips from side to side without forcing the movement.
cues.rotationCue: Lie on your side with knees bent. Rotate your upper back to open your chest while keeping your knees together.
cues.ankleCue: With your heel grounded, gently guide your knee forward over your foot. Repeat on both sides.
